body: Single still product photograph: rugged matte-black chronograph watch with orange accents tightly framed between textured rocks. Ultra-close macro, cold mountain mist and warm grazing sun, specular highlights on bezel and sapphire, blurred alpine peaks. Lock the watch as the central hero; show plausible dial, hands, buttons and strap. No camera movement, no logo, no text overlays. 4:5 portrait.
